## v0.5.25: Memory without a Memory Space and a choice of where to save / 没有记忆空间也能工作的记忆，以及保存位置的选择

Publishes [#343](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/343), [#344](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/344), [#345](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/345), [#346](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/346), [#347](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/347), [#348](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/348) and [#349](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/349).
- When working memory is full and no Memory Space can take an archive, the Runtime Source keeps the entries it moves out in a local archive and completes the write instead of refusing it.
- **Save to memory** lets you choose working memory, the user profile or an active Memory Space, or leave it to the Agent; an edited candidate can be sent again.
- An Agent or `/mnemon forget <ID>` can forget a memory by its exact id.
- An archive into Mnemon Native no longer fails on an entry the space already holds.
- **Direct search** and **Find related memories** no longer count as use.
- Component settings render in Settings shells that draw the configuration without DSH's slot renderer.

发布 [#343](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/343)、[#344](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/344)、[#345](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/345)、[#346](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/346)、[#347](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/347)、[#348](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/348) 与 [#349](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/349)。
- 工作记忆写满、又没有记忆空间能接收归档时，运行时记忆把移出的条目留在本地存档，并完成这次写入，而不是拒绝。
- **保存到记忆**可以选择工作记忆、用户画像或某个激活的记忆空间，也可以交给 Agent 决定；修改后的候选可以再次提交。
- Agent 或 `/mnemon forget <ID>` 可以按精确 id 遗忘记忆。
- 归档到 Mnemon Native 时，遇到空间里已有的条目不再失败。
- **直接检索**与**查找相关记忆**不再算作使用。
- 不经过 DSH slot 渲染器绘制配置的设置外壳中，也能显示各组件的设置。

The Starter advances to **0.5.25**, Runtime Memory to **0.5.13**, Project Documents to **0.5.10**, Memory Spaces to **0.5.17**, the Layered strategy to **0.5.8** and Mnemon Native to **0.5.9**. The other 12 component versions are unchanged.

Starter 升至 **0.5.25**，运行时记忆升至 **0.5.13**，项目档案升至 **0.5.10**，记忆空间升至 **0.5.17**，分层策略升至 **0.5.8**，Mnemon Native 升至 **0.5.9**；其余 12 个组件版本不变。

From v0.5.22, use **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then restart DSH. Or install the exact version:

从 v0.5.22 可使用**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**，然后重启 DSH；也可安装精确版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.25
```

No memory migration is required. 无需迁移已有记忆。
